# Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (Adyvka)
> Official Portfolio & Developer Knowledge Base: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id](https://adyvkapratama.my.id)

Rafif Sava Adyvka Pratama (widely recognized online as **Adyvka**) is a Software Engineer & Systems Architect based in West Java, Indonesia. He specializes in designing resilient, highly scalable distributed systems, enterprise platforms, and multi-platform applications across web, mobile, and cloud infrastructure.

- **Current Role**: Software Engineer & Project Manager at PT Intisel Prodaktifakom
- **Education**: SMK IDN Boarding School (Final Year · Year XII) & Harvard University CS50 Alumni
- **Specializations**: Clean Architecture, SOLID Principles, System Design, Polyglot Development, Distributed Systems, Multi-Tenant ERPs, RBAC & Cloud Security
- **Languages**: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Dart, PHP, C/C++, SQL
- **Platforms & Frameworks**: NestJS, React, Next.js, Flutter, PostgreSQL, Docker, Laravel, Express, AWS

---

## Flagship Systems & Shipped Projects

### 1. [Databank ERP Ecosystem](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/databank)
- **Role**: Lead Systems Engineer & Project Manager (PT Intisel Prodaktifakom)
- **Stack**: React 19, NestJS 11, PostgreSQL 14+, Prisma ORM, Docker, Playwright, React Virtuoso
- **Summary**: Enterprise telecommunication operations platform managing 50,000+ data rows lag-free, automated Huawei ISDP scraping bots, 3-stage sequential digital signature approval pipelines (PS/SS -> RPM -> SPM), 65 granular RBAC permissions, and GPS geofenced workforce attendance integrated into payroll.

### 2. [KEPK UMJ (Health Research Ethics Committee)](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/kepk)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/kepk](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/kepk)
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer & Server Architect (Universitas Muhammadiyah Jakarta)
- **Stack**: React, Vite, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, Biznet Cloud VPS
- **Summary**: National health research ethics evaluation system managing clinical ethical clearances, 4-tier sequential review protocols, and cryptographic document verification deployed on self-hosted cloud VPS.

### 3. [PusakaKu (Indonesian Cultural Heritage Platform)](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/pusakaku)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/pusakaku](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/pusakaku)
- **Role**: Team Lead & Lead Developer (ICOMFEST 2025 Champion)
- **Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, Gamification Engine
- **Summary**: 1st Place National Web Design Winner revitalizing 10+ endangered Indonesian traditional games through interactive ethnography and a 10-stage gamified assessment quiz engine.

### 4. [Terastani (Smart Agricultural Marketplace)](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/terastani)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/terastani](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/terastani)
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer
- **Stack**: Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
- **Summary**: Agricultural B2B commerce network connecting local farming cooperatives directly with urban distribution networks with real-time price index tracking.

### 5. [Ruang Tumbuh (Pediatric Development Screening)](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/ruangtumbuh)
- **URL**: [https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/ruangtumbuh](https://adyvkapratama.my.id/projects/ruangtumbuh)
- **Role**: Full Stack Engineer
- **Stack**: Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Framer Motion
- **Summary**: Clinical pediatric milestone screening platform standardizing developmental assessments according to national pediatric guidelines.
